# Proposed SCI-POINT v0.1 r0.3 scientific-owner freeze

## Proposed disposition

**Conditionally freeze SCI-POINT v0.1 document revision r0.3 as the final
targeted Stage B generic scientific contract, subject to the retained approvals
below.**

The proposed freeze accepts the owner-bound SCI-VAL semantic crosswalk; exact
producer lifecycle and eight records; signed diagnostic identities; fixed,
POINT-full-procedure/parent-fixed, and whole-chain response separation; exact
route response identity/status; downstream child-decision separation; exact
`W_fit` mappings; inherited parent observation/exposure lineage; repaired early
stop behavior; conditional covariance; preserved REQ/PRED/UNAV identities; and
source/build/archive closure.

## Conditions retained

- No numerical POINT route is approved.
- `POINT-COMPATIBILITY-METHOD v0.1`, `POINT-FORMAL-ERROR-METHOD v0.1`, and
  `POINT-FULL-MAP-RMS-METHOD v0.1` remain separately unavailable pending
  content-bound owner approval.
- The four named-use profiles remain unregistered and unevaluable drafts.
- Exact numerical route boundary instances remain unavailable; every route must
  nevertheless expose its exact parent-response identity/status.
- Fixed POINT/parent response, POINT-full-procedure/parent-fixed response,
  whole-chain full-procedure response, and observational bias/accuracy remain
  separately unavailable under their distinct release conditions.
- The absolute-magnitude formal standardization identity is not admitted.
- No implementation, representation, response, covariance, uncertainty,
  validation, accuracy, performance, readiness, production, authorization, or
  Unity claim is accepted.

## Later owner actions

1. Approve the three content-bound method records independently.
2. Approve exact numerical parent-route boundary instances.
3. Review and register each draft named-use profile with its policy owner.
4. Separately authorize any fixed response, POINT-full-procedure/parent-fixed
   response, whole-chain full-procedure response, or empirical observational
   bias/accuracy product sought.
5. Separately request and authorize any absolute-magnitude diagnostic or legacy
   alias after proving exact mathematical identity.

Acceptance would freeze only the r0.3 conditional contract and closure record;
it would not approve any later method, route, profile, response, implementation,
or production claim by implication.
